verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community remark that card backs allow a 'real discussion', which points to threaded comments on cards inside Trello rather than a dedicated team chat. The Slack capture into the Inbox [trello-docs-1] pulls messages in; it is not chatting inside Trello, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-app messaging or comments, real-time team chat or channels, mentions and notifications, and hands-on corroboration beyond one community anecdote.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: You could have a real discussion on the back of the card.
